1: #!/usr/bin/env -S uv run --script
2: # Managed by ai-standards template: templates/ai-infrastructure/scripts/code_index.py
3: # Do not edit manually unless you remove this marker.

5: # /// script
6: # requires-python = ">=3.11,<3.14"
7: # dependencies = ["chromadb>=1.1,<2"]
8: # ///
9: """Freshness-gated Chroma code index for a project.
10: 
11: Managed by ai-standards. Generalized from a battle-tested reference implementation.
12: Lives at ``<project>/.ai-standards/scripts/code_index.py``; configuration is read
13: from ``<project>/.ai-standards/code-index.toml``.
14: 
15: Design notes (encoded to avoid re-discovering expensive setup traps):
16: - Indexing is incremental by per-file SHA-256 content hash.
17: - The manifest is saved atomically (tmp-file + replace) so an interrupted build
18:   resumes without re-embedding finished files.
19: - Embeddings are upserted across file boundaries in batches, not one upsert per
20:   source file, to avoid the per-upsert startup-cost bottleneck.
21: - Queries refresh first and block on a refresh failure, so retrieval never runs
22:   against a stale index.
23: """
24: 
25: from __future__ import annotations
26: 
27: import argparse
28: import fnmatch
29: import hashlib
30: import json
31: import sys
32: import tomllib
33: from dataclasses import dataclass
34: from pathlib import Path
35: from typing import Any, Iterable
36: 
37: 
38: SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve()
39: WORKSPACE = SCRIPT.parents[2]
40: CONFIG_PATH = WORKSPACE / ".ai-standards" / "code-index.toml"
41: 
42: 
43: @dataclass(frozen=True)
44: class Settings:
45:     raw: dict[str, Any]
46:     workspace: Path
47:     chroma_dir: Path
48:     manifest: Path
49: 
50:     @classmethod
51:     def load(cls) -> "Settings":
52:         raw = tomllib.loads(CONFIG_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
53:         config_dir = CONFIG_PATH.parent
54:         workspace = (config_dir / raw["workspace"]).resolve()
55:         return cls(
56:             raw=raw,
57:             workspace=workspace,
58:             chroma_dir=(workspace / raw["chroma_dir"]).resolve(),
59:             manifest=(workspace / raw["manifest"]).resolve(),
60:         )
61: 
62: 
63: def sha256(data: bytes) -> str:
64:     return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
65: 
66: 
67: def batched(items: list[Any], size: int = 32) -> Iterable[list[Any]]:
68:     for start in range(0, len(items), size):
69:         yield items[start : start + size]
70: 
71: 
72: class CodeIndex:
73:     def __init__(self, settings: Settings) -> None:
74:         self.settings = settings
75:         self.settings.chroma_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
76:         self.settings.manifest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
77:         self.manifest = self._load_manifest()
78: 
79:     def _load_manifest(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
80:         if not self.settings.manifest.exists():
81:             return {"version": 1, "collections": {}}
82:         return json.loads(self.settings.manifest.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
83: 
84:     def _save_manifest(self) -> None:
85:         temporary = self.settings.manifest.with_suffix(".tmp")
86:         temporary.write_text(
87:             json.dumps(self.manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True),
88:             encoding="utf-8",
89:         )
90:         temporary.replace(self.settings.manifest)
91: 
92:     def _collection_configs(self, requested: str | None) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
93:         configs = self.settings.raw["collection"]
94:         if requested is None:
95:             return configs
96:         selected = [item for item in configs if item["name"] == requested]
97:         if not selected:
98:             names = ", ".join(item["name"] for item in configs)
99:             raise SystemExit(f"Unknown collection {requested!r}; expected one of: {names}")
100:         return selected
101: 
102:     def _excluded(self, relative: str) -> bool:
103:         return any(
104:             fnmatch.fnmatch(relative, pattern)
105:             for pattern in self.settings.raw["exclude_globs"]
106:         )
107: 
108:     def _eligible_files(self, config: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Path]:
109:         extensions = set(self.settings.raw["include_extensions"])
110:         maximum = int(self.settings.raw["max_file_bytes"])
111:         result: dict[str, Path] = {}
112:         ignored_dirs = {
113:             ".git", ".idea", ".next", ".venv", "build", "coverage", "dist",
114:             "generated", "graphify-out", "node_modules", "target", "vendor",
115:             "staticfiles", "context_portal", ".ai-standards", ".basic-memory",
116:         }
117:         for configured_root in config["roots"]:
118:             root = self.settings.workspace / configured_root
119:             if not root.exists():
120:                 continue
121:             for path in root.rglob("*"):
122:                 if not path.is_file() or any(part in ignored_dirs for part in path.parts):
123:                     continue
124:                 relative = path.relative_to(self.settings.workspace).as_posix()
125:                 if path.suffix.lower() not in extensions or self._excluded(relative):
126:                     continue
127:                 try:
128:                     if path.stat().st_size > maximum:
129:                         continue
130:                 except OSError:
131:                     continue
132:                 result[relative] = path
133:         return result
134: 
135:     def _chunks(self, source: str, text: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
136:         lines = text.splitlines()
137:         size = int(self.settings.raw["chunk_lines"])
138:         overlap = int(self.settings.raw["chunk_overlap"])
139:         step = max(1, size - overlap)
140:         chunks: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
141:         for start in range(0, max(1, len(lines)), step):
142:             selected = lines[start : start + size]
143:             if not selected and chunks:
144:                 break
145:             document = "\n".join(selected).strip()
146:             if not document:
147:                 continue
148:             digest = sha256(f"{source}:{start}:{document}".encode())
149:             chunks.append(
150:                 {
151:                     "id": digest,
152:                     "document": document,
153:                     "metadata": {
154:                         "source": source,
155:                         "extension": Path(source).suffix.lower(),
156:                         "start_line": start + 1,
157:                         "end_line": min(len(lines), start + size),
158:                         "content_hash": sha256(document.encode()),
159:                     },
160:                 }
161:             )
162:             if start + size >= len(lines):
163:                 break
164:         return chunks
165: 
166:     def refresh(self, requested: str | None = None) -> None:
167:         import chromadb
168: 
169:         client = chromadb.PersistentClient(path=str(self.settings.chroma_dir))
170:         for config in self._collection_configs(requested):
171:             name = config["name"]
172:             collection = client.get_or_create_collection(name=name)
173:             state = self.manifest["collections"].setdefault(name, {})
174:             files = self._eligible_files(config)
175:             current_sources = set(files)
176:             removed = sorted(set(state) - current_sources)
177:             changed = 0
178:             unchanged = 0
179:             pending: list[tuple[str, str, list[dict[str, Any]]]] = []
180: 
181:             for source in removed:
182:                 ids = state[source].get("ids", [])
183:                 if ids:
184:                     collection.delete(ids=ids)
185:                 del state[source]
186: 
187:             for source, path in sorted(files.items()):
188:                 try:
189:                     data = path.read_bytes()
190:                     content_hash = sha256(data)
191:                     if state.get(source, {}).get("hash") == content_hash:
192:                         unchanged += 1
193:                         continue
194:                     text = data.decode("utf-8")
195:                 except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError):
196:                     continue
197: 
198:                 chunks = self._chunks(source, text)
199:                 pending.append((source, content_hash, chunks))
200: 
201:             # Embed across file boundaries. Chroma's embedding model has a fixed
202:             # startup cost per upsert; one upsert per source file makes an initial
203:             # workspace build unnecessarily slow.
204:             for file_batch in batched(pending, 100):
205:                 all_chunks: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
206:                 for source, _, chunks in file_batch:
207:                     old_ids = state.get(source, {}).get("ids", [])
208:                     if old_ids:
209:                         collection.delete(ids=old_ids)
210:                     all_chunks.extend(chunks)
211:                 for chunk_batch in batched(all_chunks, 128):
212:                     collection.upsert(
213:                         ids=[item["id"] for item in chunk_batch],
214:                         documents=[item["document"] for item in chunk_batch],
215:                         metadatas=[item["metadata"] for item in chunk_batch],
216:                     )
217:                 for source, content_hash, chunks in file_batch:
218:                     state[source] = {
219:                         "hash": content_hash,
220:                         "ids": [item["id"] for item in chunks],
221:                     }
222:                     changed += 1
223:                 self._save_manifest()
224: 
225:             self._save_manifest()
226:             print(
227:                 f"{name}: fresh; changed={changed}, removed={len(removed)}, "
228:                 f"unchanged={unchanged}, records={collection.count()}"
229:             )
230: 
231:     def query(self, question: str, requested: str | None, limit: int) -> None:
232:         import chromadb
233: 
234:         self.refresh(requested)
235:         client = chromadb.PersistentClient(path=str(self.settings.chroma_dir))
236:         rows: list[tuple[float, str, dict[str, Any], str]] = []
237:         for config in self._collection_configs(requested):
238:             collection = client.get_collection(name=config["name"])
239:             result = collection.query(query_texts=[question], n_results=limit)
240:             documents = result.get("documents", [[]])[0]
241:             metadatas = result.get("metadatas", [[]])[0]
242:             distances = result.get("distances", [[]])[0]
243:             for distance, metadata, document in zip(distances, metadatas, documents):
244:                 rows.append((float(distance), config["name"], metadata, document))
245: 
246:         for rank, (distance, name, metadata, document) in enumerate(
247:             sorted(rows, key=lambda r: (r[0], r[1]))[:limit], 1
248:         ):
249:             excerpt = document[:1200].replace("\x00", "")
250:             print(
251:                 f"\n[{rank}] distance={distance:.4f} collection={name} "
252:                 f"source={metadata['source']}:{metadata['start_line']}-{metadata['end_line']}"
253:             )
254:             print(excerpt)
255: 
256: 
257: def parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
258:     result = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
259:     commands = result.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
260: 
261:     refresh = commands.add_parser("refresh", help="Refresh one or all Chroma collections.")
262:     refresh.add_argument("name", nargs="?", help="Optional collection name.")
263: 
264:     code_query = commands.add_parser("code-query", help="Refresh, then semantic-search the code.")
265:     code_query.add_argument("question")
266:     code_query.add_argument("--collection")
267:     code_query.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=10)
268:     return result
269: 
270: 
271: def main() -> None:
272:     args = parser().parse_args()
273:     settings = Settings.load()
274:     if args.command == "refresh":
275:         CodeIndex(settings).refresh(args.name)
276:     elif args.command == "code-query":
277:         CodeIndex(settings).query(args.question, args.collection, args.limit)
278: 
279: 
280: if __name__ == "__main__":
281:     main()

(End of file - total 281 lines)

# Core Rules

## Language & Communication
- Chat with the user in Russian.

## Engineering Workflow
- Verify information before stating it.
- Preserve existing behavior unless the user explicitly requests a change.
